newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen stable after four-day holiday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen stable after four-day holiday.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat on Monday in low investor activity after a four-day Labour Day weekend, analysts said.
Some said, however, Friday's strong gains on Wall Street might spur some Polish speculative demand and push prices higher.
Poultry producer Drosed moves to the main market of the bourse from the parallel market on Monday.
Trade in WBK shares is suspended after Allied Irish Banks (AIB), called a public tender offer for WBK shares at 14 zlotys each.
